answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must deposit collateral into a decentralized vault before transacting. Any attempt to forge illegitimate consensus identities triggers verifiable proof-of-misbehavior slashing, sinking tokens into an unrecoverable burn lagoon. By enforcing superlinear staking requirements where maintaining $n$ identities scales costs at $O(n^2)$, malicious swarm expansion rapidly incurs insurmountable economic friction.
